scope: Offline research of existing immutable Shorebird 0.1.0+16 AAB; no acceptance gate changed.

schema.execution: Existing generated parser invoked with local JShell; no Gradle or project build.

meaning: The immutable AAB contains these 52 declared Maven coordinates, graph edges and 48 source-file digests.
Pinned AGP hashes unprocessed external runtime-classpath AAR/JAR files, then merges module reports and places dependencies.pb in this AAB.
All 48 present file digests match one existing local artifact each. This is an offline byte match, not a new Gradle resolution.
The four graph records without file digests remain explicitly unbound to binary bytes.
All 52 packaging/classifier fields are empty. Repository URLs are declarations, not independent download-origin proof.
limitations: This metadata is not a complete SBOM or license/distribution-obligation review.
It does not bind POM or Gradle module descriptor contents and does not inventory Dart, Go/JNI or all Flutter runtime inputs.
It does not prove final post-R8/DEX/native packaged-code identity.
The producer selects one file if a component maps to multiple files; metadata alone cannot prove all classifiers/variant files are covered.
AAB signature authentication was not repeated; binding here is to the exact coordinator-provided artifact SHA-256.

separateApk.explanation: Same version, adjacent files and matching current mutable intermediate outputs do not establish the dependency bytes consumed by the separate APK build. AGP APK dependency metadata is compressed and hybrid-encrypted; this AAB plaintext report cannot be read back as APK plaintext proof.

proposedNextMechanism: Add an AAB-only inventory binding stage: verify artifact SHA, extract exactly one bounded metadata entry, use the pinned schema/parser, validate graph references and digests, and join external inventory binary rows by exact GAV plus SHA-256.
Keep four no-digest nodes separate and require descriptor/variant evidence before classifying them; reject unexplained binary, missing, extra, duplicate or mismatched joins.
Record binding kind aab_embedded_agp_dependencies and the exact AAB, entry and schema hashes. Preserve separate Maven descriptor and licensing gates.
For a separately built APK, require preserved same-invocation graph/input/artifact evidence, or a verifiable APK derivation from the bound AAB. Do not upgrade APK9401 evidence from this report.

actions.networkReads: Official AOSP source text and primary documentation only.

rootReview.scope: Read-only AAB metadata and cache byte matching. APK provenance, complete runtime inventory and release gates remain unproven.
